OBJECTIVE

To achieve a challenging position in the field of Information Technology with professional growth based on merit and performance, utilizing proven abilities developed through my education and experience.

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Extensive hands-on experience providing L3 Production Support for enterprise healthcare and insurance applications, including production incident troubleshooting, root cause analysis (RCA), defect resolution, hotfix deployments, and production stability improvements while working closely with global stakeholders.. Strong expertise in .NET Core, REST APIs, Azure PaaS, microservices, and event driven architectures. Experienced in supporting healthcare applications for payer organizations, building secure APIs, and modernizing legacy .NET systems to cloud ready architectures. Actively expanding expertise in Azure cloud services and enterprise integration patterns.

CORE SKILLS

Backend: .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, .NET 6/8, Web API, C#, Entity Framework, LINQ

Frontend: Angular 17/19, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery

Cloud & Azure: Azure DevOps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, SQL Database, Microsoft Azure (App Hosting, Deployment Exposure)

Architecture: Microservices, Event Driven Architecture, Pub/Sub, REST

Databases: SQL Server, Oracle, Cosmos DB

DevOps & Quality: CI/CD, SonarQube, Git, TFS, xUnit

Domains: HealthCare (Pre-Authorization, Utilization Management), Insurance, Banking

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Technical Lead, Infinite Computer Solutions, Bangalore — Sept 2023 to Now

Lead Consultant, Virtusa, Bangalore — July 2021 to Sept 2023

Senior Software Developer, Sumeru Software Solutions and its subsidiary Sumeru Enterprise Tiger Business Solutions, Bangalore — 5th Dec 2011 to 1st Mar 2021

RESPONSIBILITIES

Understand business logic from Product and Operation teams and convert it into solutions.

Responsible for software development including business analysis, technical design and architecture.

GUI Design & Development and maintenance of software and databases.

Developing WEB APIs using Flex base reference architecture; consumed in browser and mobile applications.

Provide L3 Production Support for critical enterprise applications by analyzing production incidents, debugging application and database issues, performing root cause analysis (RCA), and implementing permanent fixes.

Support production deployments, hotfix releases, change requests, and post-deployment validation while maintaining system stability.

Coordinate with business users, QA teams, infrastructure teams, and client stakeholders during high-priority production incidents to ensure timely resolution and application availability.

Automating solutions and building SSIS Packages.

Unit testing using the test plan; coordinate with testing team for System testing.

Team management, client interaction, documentation, and simultaneous work on various products.

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

Master of Technology (M. Tech).

Master in Computer Application (MCA).

Bachelor in Computer Application (BCA).

+2 Science Council of Higher Secondary Examination, Odisha.

High School Certification from Board of Secondary Education, Odisha.

ACHIEVEMENTS & CERTIFICATIONS

Exam 70-480: Programming in HTML5 with JavaScript and CSS3 (Microsoft)

Exam 70-486: Developing ASP.NET MVC Web Applications (Microsoft)

Exam 70-487: Developing Microsoft Azure and Web Services (Microsoft)

Problem Solving (Basic) (Hacker Rank)

Finance Project: Core API and Project Management — Mar 2025 to Till Date

Role: Technical Lead

Technology: .Net Core, C#, REST API, Entity Framework, SQL, Angular, Azure

Description: To develop Platform Connection Strategy - Core API to provide service capabilities to the Agent and Agency who coordinates with the Users on RegEd Products.

Participate in understanding the assigned user story and created the mapping sheet for this.

Worked on the design patterns.

Integrating multiple APIs to retrieve data.

Support – UAT Bug Fixes.

Provided L3 Production Support for Molina Healthcare and CareSource applications by investigating production incidents, debugging .NET applications and SQL queries, performing RCA, resolving high-priority production defects, and coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure SLA compliance and application availability.

Worked closely with business users and client stakeholders during production issues, supporting hotfix deployments, production validation, and continuous service improvements.

Healthcare Project: Core API and Project Management — Oct 2023 to Mar 2025 | Role: Technical Lead

Technology: .Net Core, C#, REST API, Entity Framework, SQL, Angular, Azure

Description: To develop Platform Connection Strategy - Core API to provide service capabilities to the patients who coordinates with the medical and doctors on Molina Healthcare and CareSource Products.

Participate in understanding the assigned user story and created the mapping sheet for this.

Worked on the design patterns.

Integrating multiple APIs to retrieve data.

Support – Production/UAT Bug Fixes.

RSLI-Platform Connection Strategy: Core API — June 2022 to Aug 2023

Protective Insurance: Core API — Aug 2021 to May 2022| Role: Lead Consultant

Technology: .Net Core, C#, REST API, Entity Framework, Azure DevOps, Oracle, SQL, Cosmos DB, Angular 12

Description: To develop Platform Connection Strategy - Core API to provide service capabilities to the employers who coordinates with the employees on RSL group insurance Products and Protective Insurance.

Participate in understanding the assigned user story and created the mapping sheet for this.

Worked on the design patterns.

Integrating multiple APIs to retrieving data.

Used Entity Framework Core to manage domain specific objects.

Developing microservices with .NET Core.

Used LINQ extensively for data retrieving, querying, storage and manipulation.

Update current code or changes with branch and deploy on GitHub preprod/live master then slave with reporting manager and parallelly with deploying on each.

Server testing with testing team.

SonarQube integration with Azure DevOps to maintain code quality and security.

Store unstructured data in Azure Cosmos DB with Azure Functions.

Used Azure components like Service Bus for communication between mutually interacting software applications, Message Queues, Redis Cache.

KEY PRODUCTS AND PROJECTS HANDLED IN SUMERU

ENCollect (Sumeru Product-1)

Product Name: ENCollect (Sumeru Product)

Time Span: August 2014 till date

Client: CapitalFirst, Vistaar, Varthana, VVKI, VDS etc.

No. of Team Members: 5

Framework: .Net Framework 4.0

Operating System: Windows 10

Environment: MVC4.0, LINQ, C#, WEB APIs, SQL Server 2014, SSIS

Role: Senior Software Developer

Tools: TFS

This is a Collection software and can be used by any organization who wish to automate the collection process, it can be money collection, document collection, Food Product etc.

How it works

ENCollect can be used while on Move (mobile app version) as well as through browser. Mobile ENCollect has features to use while being offline as well.

Customer from whom money needs to be collected will populate in Agent login based on business logic defined by the organization.

Agent can see responsible cases and customer details such as address and amount to be collected.

Payments are recorded in the mobile app; SMS and email notifications are sent, and hard-copy receipts can be generated through a Bluetooth printer.

Receipt functionality can be used in offline mode.

Agent is authorized to issue a Cancel Receipt and take back the money when applicable.

Details are displayed on the fly in dashboards for Agent, supervisors and Backend Admin.

Agency Manager collates payments and creates batches; Bank representatives process batch-wise payments and issue collection receipts.

Payment categories include Cheque, DD and Cash, followed by Payinslip generation and collection confirmation.

At end of day, status is updated in Core Banking System and updated payment status and new cases reflect in ENCollect next day.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Building APIs (Web services) for the product used by iPhone, Android Phone and Web Applications.

Development of modules.

Developing SSIS packages to automate solution.

Support – Production/UAT Bug Fixes.

Writing Stored Procedures to generate daily/monthly reports.

Role: Senior Software Developer
Tools: TFS
This is a Collection software and can be used by any organization who wish to automate the collection process, it can be money collection, document collection, Food Product etc.
How it works
ENCollect can be used while on Move (mobile app version) as well as through browser. Mobile ENCollect has features to use while being offline as well.
Customer from whom money needs to be collected will populate in Agent login based on business logic defined by the organization.
Agent can see responsible cases and customer details such as address and amount to be collected.
Payments are recorded in the mobile app; SMS and email notifications are sent, and hard-copy receipts can be generated through a Bluetooth printer.
Receipt functionality can be used in offline mode.
Agent is authorized to issue a Cancel Receipt and take back the money when applicable.
Details are displayed on the fly in dashboards for Agent, supervisors and Backend Admin.
Agency Manager collates payments and creates batches; Bank representatives process batch-wise payments and issue collection receipts.
Payment categories include Cheque, DD and Cash, followed by Payinslip generation and collection confirmation.
At end of day, status is updated in Core Banking System and updated payment status and new cases reflect in ENCollect next day.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Building APIs (Web services) for the product used by iPhone, Android Phone and Web Applications.
Development of modules.
Developing SSIS packages to automate solution.
Support – Production/UAT Bug Fixes.
Writing Stored Procedures to generate daily/monthly reports.

blocks.text: ENCollect can be used while on Move (mobile app version) as well as through browser. Mobile ENCollect has features to use while being offline as well.
blocks.reason: Follows a detected heading in the same layout lane; verify visually

blocks.text: Customer from whom money needs to be collected will populate in Agent login based on business logic defined by the organization.
blocks.reason: Follows a detected heading in the same layout lane; verify visually

blocks.text: Agent can see responsible cases and customer details such as address and amount to be collected.
blocks.reason: Follows a detected heading in the same layout lane; verify visually

blocks.text: Payments are recorded in the mobile app; SMS and email notifications are sent, and hard-copy receipts can be generated through a Bluetooth printer.
blocks.reason: Follows a detected heading in the same layout lane; verify visually

blocks.text: Receipt functionality can be used in offline mode.
blocks.reason: Follows a detected heading in the same layout lane; verify visually

blocks.text: Agent is authorized to issue a Cancel Receipt and take back the money when applicable.
blocks.reason: Follows a detected heading in the same layout lane; verify visually

blocks.text: Details are displayed on the fly in dashboards for Agent, supervisors and Backend Admin.
blocks.reason: Follows a detected heading in the same layout lane; verify visually

blocks.text: Agency Manager collates payments and creates batches; Bank representatives process batch-wise payments and issue collection receipts.
blocks.reason: Follows a detected heading in the same layout lane; verify visually

blocks.text: Payment categories include Cheque, DD and Cash, followed by Payinslip generation and collection confirmation.
blocks.reason: Follows a detected heading in the same layout lane; verify visually

blocks.text: At end of day, status is updated in Core Banking System and updated payment status and new cases reflect in ENCollect next day.
blocks.reason: Follows a detected heading in the same layout lane; verify visually
